children: ZEO ScientifiX announced plans to expand commercial and provider-support operations into Georgia and Tennessee after each state enacted new regenerative medicine laws.
Announced planned expansion into Georgia and Tennessee to support providers under new state regenerative medicine frameworks.
New laws (Georgia HB 1275; Tennessee HB 2246) set sourcing, documentation, consent, scope of practice, and safety oversight rules.
Tennessee law explicitly may include certain exosome-based products when statutory product and manufacturing criteria are met.
ZEO will offer education, product-quality documentation, clinical collaboration, and compliance-forward provider resources.
Company frames expansion as scalable model to support additional states and grow its Southeast footprint beyond Florida.
